name: sentinel/extend-budget
description: Extend budget limits for a running or paused pipeline. Merges new limits into existing checkpoint budget.

params.name: handle
params.description: Sentinel handle ID to extend budget for

params.name: maxTimeSecs
params.description: New max time limit in seconds (e.g., 3600 for 1 hour)

params.name: maxCostUsd
params.description: New max cost limit in USD (e.g., 5.00)

params.name: maxIterations
params.description: New max iteration limit (full pipeline loops, not agent turns)

results.name: handle
results.description: The sentinel handle whose budget was extended

results.name: budgetLimits
results.description: The new merged budget limits after extension

examples.description: Double time limit for a running pipeline
